No recall for our NDC per [search-recall-43].

The risk is low_stock_only, meaning the only risk is low stock (8.2 days cover). There's no shortage for our exact package.

Claim 3: No ongoing recall for this NDC. Cite [search-recall-43].

But limit to 1-3 claims. I'll do 3 claims.
